notes: Corrección estructural autorizada 09/11/2026: Cloudflare Pages transforma /book.html en /book; Android 0.0.19 bloqueaba esa ruta en onShouldStartLoadWithRequest, impidiendo arrancar BOOK y Recuerdos. 0.0.20 utiliza directamente ruta canónica https://havana-nice-v2.pages.dev/book; control de navegación y refresh coherentes; smoke test real de Cloudflare Pages verifica HTML, JS y ruta canónica. Mantiene una sola sesión nativa, mismos contratos, PageFlip 3D, Chat, Repertorio, Familia, Calendario, datos D1/R2 y Worker sin cambios. Certificado debe ser compatible con 0.0.19, actualizar encima sin borrar. Prueba final en dispositivo pendiente. GitHub Actions release builder uses the official direct Gradle CDN and bounded retries for 502/503/504 network errors observed in previous attempts; no changes to app source or signing. Build now prefers the Gradle 9.x CLI preinstalled on the official GitHub Ubuntu 26 image; fallback to same generated Gradle wrapper if unavailable. Signed APK checks unchanged. Gradle version selection uses a literal-dot version regex guard. Build must use Gradle 9.4.1, pinned to official SHA-256 2ab2958f...7ec6cb, using verified HTTPS mirrors during Gradle CDN 504; preinstalled Gradle 9.8.2 was rejected for Kotlin ABI incompatibility.
